answer: An agent economy can anchor each identity to a licensed sparrow rehabilitation aviary. One rehabilitator tends one aviary, bands each released bird, and archives a molted plume from it in a sable-lined case as a physical fingerprint. Random spot-checks summon the holder to present that exact bird and plume on camera within hours, and one person cannot run two aviaries at once. The license fee in outside money doubles per further identity on the same funding trail, so each extra fake costs another real aviary, another licensed rehabilitator, and twice the prior fee.
